answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sparrow tag. The grove cap is checked at intake and inlet reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
